item.title: 【Albums (lossless)】FLAC - O'Douling - Day at the Races (2004)
item.description:
O'Douling - Day at the Races (2004)

Day at the Races is the debut solo studio album by O'Douling, best known for his appearance as Walter on The Real World and as the frontman of the Celtic rock band The Wild Celts. Continuing in the same Celtic rock tradition for which he is best known, the album blends folk melodies, rock instrumentation, and Irish music influences throughout. This independent release is presented here for preservation in its original CD quality of 16-bit/44.1 kHz. The album has long been out of print and remains largely undocumented on major music databases such as Discogs, MusicBrainz, and AccurateRip, making archival preservation especially important. Scans of the original album booklet are included in the designated folder.

Note: Despite this being lifted from the CD, only two songs are truly lossless ("Stars and Moonlight" and "Angels"). They have erroneously used lossy files for the rest of the songs during the creation of the CD. Unfortunately, because this album is so rare, there's really not much I can do about it. There's no other source.
